topology_analysis.description: MMI-based 1-to-4 optical power splitter with central multimode interference region and four tapered outputs

function_defining_knobs.mmi_width: MMI body width - controls mode interference pattern (critical)
function_defining_knobs.mmi_length: MMI body length - determines splitting ratio (critical)
function_defining_knobs.output_taper_length: Length of output tapers - affects loss (critical for adiabatic transition)

iterations.change_made: Wrong topology - used cascaded Y-branches instead of MMI
Fixed to MMI topology but body too narrow (11 um vs target ~22-24 um)
Scaled MMI to 22 um width, improved output tapers. BEST RESULT.
Rebuilt with continuous geometry, still had gap issues
Narrowed output taper bases but made slots too thin - went backwards

final_result.note: Did not reach IoU >= 0.85 target. Device topology correct but dimensional tuning needs more iterations.
